d:
JDU men Nishant Kumar ki bhumika aur bhavishy ki rajniti ko lekar naee charcha shuru ho gaee hai. kya Nishant Kumar agle 30 sal tak parti ki kaman sanbhalenge? agar aisa hai to Nitish Kumar ke vicharon, siddhanton aur netritv ki virasat ka kya hoga? janie is pure rajnitik ghatnakram ke mayne.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
